Section: Section 8 — Turning Priorities Into a Realistic Daily Plan
Configured_Value: 5 tasks maximum per day — CLARIFIED: this is a CEILING, not a guaranteed flat count. It's achievable only in the best case, when travel time between that day's actual stops stays well under the 180-min ceiling (R1.2). As travel time grows toward that ceiling, fewer visit-slots fit in the remaining budget and the effective number of tasks goes down — see Routing Agent R1.4 for the live formula.
Formula: COUNT(Daily_Task_List) ≤ 5 at the BO Scoring Engine stage (visit-duration-only math, no travel time yet). The Routing Agent re-checks this against REAL travel time between the specific candidate stops (Haversine-based) and may trim it further — see R1.4, GR-R5. 5 is a nominal upper bound handed downstream, not the guaranteed daily count.
